methodology.gates: runtime-only monkey-patches on TrendFollowingStrategy.evaluate; new entries only
methodology.costs: original base scenario: spread 0.25 / slippage 2pt / commission 7$/lot/side, swap off
methodology.walk_forward: 10 folds x 182d test, expanding train, frozen config (same as original)
methodology.bootstrap: 10000 resamples, seed 42; permutation tests 10000 shuffles, two-sided
methodology.multiple_testing: 10 variants compared; expect ~1-2 false positives at p<0.05 among timing buckets; treat small-n results as exploratory
